channel.title: Uncle Cat AI Radar

item.title: X Square releases WALL-OSS-1.0 for zero-shot robot control
item.description: X Square’s new embodied model unifies language, vision and action during pretraining, reporting 55.1% zero-shot success across real-robot tests.

item.title: ⚡ 9 quick hits — Morning edition, Nov 23
item.description: · A study of 168 brainstorming participants found two AI partners increased idea volume but substantially reduced human-authored contributions.（arXiv） · SkillPrivus audited 726 public agent skills and flagged potential privacy violations in 307, including sensitive inference and unexpected disclosure.（arXiv） · Researchers found reinforcement learning restored reasoning accuracy after severely corrupted supervised fine-tuning, reaching 69.30% from minimal incorrect traces.（arXiv） · Search-native pretraining produced a 1.4B QueryLM that matched or beat a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline on knowledge-intensive tasks.（arXiv） · FORTH paired tactile sensing with forward-only control and reached 97.6% average success across three LIBERO suites while cutting peak memory 7.12-fold.（arXiv） · Skill-JEPA raised long-horizon goal success from 42% to 62% by aligning world-model action spaces with planner sampling.（arXiv） · GeoCloak uses localized semantic image edits to reduce multimodal geolocation accuracy while preserving perceptual quality better than pixel perturbations.（arXiv） · GRAFT generated adversarial MCP tool descriptions that achieved higher attack success and lower detection across five defenses.（arXiv） · Sakana AI said its new Sawara language model is being developed for agent use, with a small model targeted for open weights next spring.（X / SakanaAILabs）

item.title: ⚡ 6 quick hits — Evening edition, Nov 22
item.description: · OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed perplexity as a possible metric for measuring and limiting the speed of AI development.（TechCrunch） · GitHub said Copilot Fusion can automatically decide whether to route a prompt to one model instead of requiring manual model selection.（X / GitHub） · NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B reasoning vision-language-action model designed for DRIVE Thor automotive computers.（MarkTechPost） · Together AI showcased Qwen3 TTS controls that change delivery style while preserving the same voice and spoken words.（X / Together AI） · A simulated workplace study found leading coding agents completed fewer than one in ten multi-step software tasks despite strong isolated benchmark scores.（The Decoder） · Perplexity introduced Monitor API, turning web search into a continuously running watchdog for recurring information needs.（The Decoder）
